answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 148999 Country: india Title: audit of banks hala? Question: Is it halal to audit of accounts of banks, financial institutes and insurance companies? Please give reason clearly. Is it halal to do job in an MNC company which has multi products including loan and financing and other halal products. I heard that if 50% income from haram products it is not halal to job in it. Please give clarification. I am waiting for your reply. Answer ID: 148999 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 686/1535/H=1/1439) Generally, Banks, Financial Institutions and Insurance Companies are involved in more than 50% haram business hence one should avoid them. For details see the book “Fatawa Usmani” vol. 3, p. 327, by Maulana Mufti Muhammad Taqi Usmani Sahib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
